  Scenario: AC7 The release publishes on one topic only and reaches the operations through the gateway-bff route (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rendered chart and the published topics of rwb-document
    When the contract step runs
    Then the release publishes on rwb.document.events.v1 and subscribes to no topic of this service
    Then the checked-fields read and the extraction operations are reached through the gateway-bff composite route and the release declares no path of its own

  Scenario: AC8 The provided operations answer 401, 403 and 404 on their error paths (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the provided operations of the chart and the gateway-bff route
    When a call without credentials, a call outside the rwb-document role and a call for an unknown document are made
    Then the unauthenticated call is answered 401, the call outside the role is answered 403 and the unknown document is answered 404

  Scenario: AC9 A retried or timed-out activity never reports success (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the extraction and evaluation activities of queue rwb-document
    When an activity fails or exceeds its timeout
    Then the activity is retried under the retry policy of the values file
    Then an activity that exceeds its timeout is recorded as failed and never as complete
    Then the retry count and the timeout value are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E2025-OPS-AC9)

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a document record that holds a status
    When a status change the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused and the record keeps its current status
